headline: Custom Keybindings, Academic Transliteration & Scholarly Typography
summary: This release introduces full keyboard shortcut customization, automated academic Islamic transliteration with smart diacritics, upgraded typography, and release logging.

items.title: Academic Diacritic Auto-Formatting
items.description: Standard terms auto-expand on word completion (Quran → Qur'ān, Hadith → Ḥadīth, Tawhid → Tawḥīd). Fast inline modifiers enable typing a= for ā, h. for ḥ, s. for ṣ, d. for ḍ, t. for ṭ, z. for ẓ, etc.

items.title: Bidirectional Isolation & Directional Protection
items.description: Enhanced Unicode isolation prevents cursor jumping and punctuation distortion when mixing Arabic and English text in paragraphs.

items.title: Customizable Keybindings Engine
items.description: Configure any shortcut in Settings → Shortcuts with interactive key combination recording and real-time conflict detection.

items.title: Command Palette & Quick Switcher Integration
items.description: Trigger actions and navigate notes with flexible custom key mappings.

items.title: WCAG AA Contrast Compliance
items.description: Refined muted text tokens across light and dark reading themes for guaranteed high contrast and legibility.

items.title: What's New Release Log
items.description: Review new features and capabilities directly from the Help and Command Palette menu.

headline: Foundational Release: Offline Studio Core
summary: Initial launch of SubmissionArchives Studio with local Markdown vaults, Rust-backed Quran search, bidirectional links, and multi-modal editor views.

items.title: Multi-Modal Views
items.description: Write mode for keyboard writing, Blocks mode with drag handles, and Page mode with ruler and typewriter scrolling.

items.title: Offline Quran Embeds
items.description: Type /quran 1:1-7 to insert bilingual verses queried directly from local offline database in sub-milliseconds.
